system: Calma Student Burnout Risk Estimation & Early-Warning System
organization: VIT Vellore - Educational AI & Wellbeing Prototype

assessments.title: Student Burnout & Academic Strain Screening
assessments.purpose: Self-reported screening of academic emotional exhaustion, study detachment, and academic confidence.
assessments.validation_status: Project-created screening instrument; non-diagnostic; maps to HistGradientBoosting Model B inputs.

assessments.title: Study Habits & Workload Assessment
assessments.purpose: Collects structured information on daily study duration, pacing, break frequency, and concentration patterns.
assessments.target_population: Students engaged in active course modules and project sprints
assessments.validation_status: Empirical behavioural assessment; self-reported study habits.

assessments.title: Sleep & Recovery Assessment
assessments.purpose: Evaluates sleep consistency, restorative quality, and academic interference with circadian wind-down.
assessments.target_population: Students observing sleep disruptions or late-night study cycles
assessments.validation_status: Educational self-reflection questionnaire; not a clinical sleep disorder diagnostic.

assessments.title: Academic Workload & Context Assessment
assessments.purpose: Maps current credit load, upcoming lab reports/exams, perceived assignment rigor, and family/social pressures.

assessments.title: Optional Daily Student Check-In
assessments.purpose: Rapid 1-minute daily reflection capturing momentary energy, task manageability, and break readiness.
assessments.target_population: Students wanting light daily mindfulness and pacing calibration
